sources.sourceName: Geological Survey of India (GSI) Bhusanket / NLFC
sources.organization: Geological Survey of India (Ministry of Mines, Government of India)
sources.transformation: Extracted geocoded historical bulletins from GSI NLFC annual landslide publications (Teesta Basin 2023, Tupul 2022, Haflong 2022, Melthum 2024, Ambassa 2024, Sohra 2022, Tawang Km 14 2022, Dzudza 2021, Daporijo 2024, Sonapur 2023, Phek 2024)
sources.limitations: Direct automated GIS shapefile downloads require Indian government organizational login and CAPTCHA authentication. Records in SentinalX are manually curated from verified open disaster bulletins.

sources.sourceName: ISRO / NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (1998–2022)
sources.organization: National Remote Sensing Centre (ISRO / Department of Space, Government of India)
sources.transformation: Extracted published geospatial landslide vulnerability coordinates for high-risk NER districts (Gangtok NH-10, Sessa Bomdila, Guwahati hills, Shillong NH-6, Lunglei, Dharmanagar)
sources.limitations: Full nationwide GIS shapefile repository is an open PDF atlas with district maps rather than a public raw CSV API.

sources.organization: NASA Earth Science Data Systems (Goddard Space Flight Center)
sources.transformation: Filtered by NER bounding box (Lat 21.5°N–29.5°N, Lon 88.0°E–97.5°E) and validated historical landslide dates and triggers (Singtam 2019, Itanagar 2020, Cachar 2020, Senapati 2018, Champhai 2021, Mokokchung 2019)
sources.limitations: Historical reporting is denser near major transport arteries and media-reported events.

sources.transformation: Queried hourly precipitation and soil moisture at exact event coordinates; aggregated strictly antecedent accumulation windows (1h, 3h, 24h, 72h) prior to event timestamp
sources.limitations: Values are meteorological model reanalysis (ERA5-Land 0.1° / ~9km grid), not direct physical tipping-bucket rain-gauge measurements.

sources.sourceName: Copernicus DEM (GLO-90 Public Digital Elevation Model)
sources.organization: European Space Agency (ESA) & Airbus Defence and Space
sources.transformation: Queried 90-meter digital elevation model grid cell at sample coordinates; calculated slope gradient (degrees) and aspect (degrees)
sources.limitations: Calculated at 90-meter spatial resolution (GLO-90). High-resolution 30-meter (GLO-30) requires ESA token-authenticated pipelines.

sources.transformation: Queried regional seismic events within 300km radius during 7-day pre-event window to compute peak ground motion indicator index
sources.limitations: Detection completeness threshold is Magnitude 2.5+ in the Eastern Himalayan belt.

sources.transformation: None (Earthdata token authentication required for direct HDF5 raster granule download)
sources.limitations: NASA Earthdata Login and Bearer token authorization are required for automated HDF5 granule retrieval. SentinalX transparently uses Open-Meteo ERA5-Land reanalysis archive as the verified operational meteorological data provider.
